name: firefox-price-tracker
description: Track product prices and get notified when they change.

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(fs => fs.rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir build --overwrite-dest
